# IconSnag

> Free icon and emoji search engine. 45,000+ icons from 18 open-source collections, downloadable as SVG or PNG.

## What is IconSnag?

IconSnag is a free web app at https://iconsnag.com for searching and downloading icons and emoji. No sign-up, no ads, no cost. All icons come from open-source collections with permissive licenses.

## Icon Sources (18 collections, 45,000+ icons)

- Material Design Icons (7,188 icons) - Pictogrammers, Apache 2.0
- Tabler Icons (4,985 icons) - MIT
- OpenMoji (4,469 emoji) - CC-BY-SA-4.0
- Google Material Symbols (3,976 icons) - Apache 2.0
- Twemoji (3,939 emoji) - MIT
- Google Noto Emoji (3,691 emoji) - Apache 2.0
- Simple Icons (3,402 brand logos) - CC0
- Microsoft Fluent Icons (2,868 icons) - MIT
- Remix Icon (1,690 icons) - Apache 2.0
- Lucide Icons (1,671 icons) - ISC
- Microsoft Fluent Emoji (1,595 emoji) - MIT
- Phosphor Icons (1,494 icons) - MIT
- Bootstrap Icons (1,409 icons) - MIT
- OpenFinTech (1,181 payment/fintech icons) - MIT
- VS Code Icons (1,154 file type icons) - MIT
- Devicon (578 developer/tech icons) - MIT
- GitHub Octicons (349 icons) - MIT
- Payment Iconset (24 payment brand icons) - MIT

## Download Formats

- SVG: Vector format, scalable, editable
- PNG: Rasterized at any size with transparent background

## MCP Server for AI Assistants

IconSnag has an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI coding assistants search and retrieve icons programmatically.

To add it to Claude Code:
```
claude mcp add iconsnag -- npx @iconsnag/mcp
```

Or install globally:
```
npm install -g @iconsnag/mcp
```

The MCP server provides tools to search icons by keyword, browse by collection, filter by tag, and get SVG URLs or content.
